name: Pterodactyl Configurable Options
description: Configurable options for Pterodactyl game server provisioning

options.label: Location
options.name: location_id
options.description: The Pterodactyl node location to deploy the server to

options.label: Nest
options.name: nest_id
options.description: The Pterodactyl nest ID to use for the server

options.label: Egg
options.name: egg_id
options.description: The Pterodactyl egg ID to use for the server

options.label: Port Range
options.name: port_range
options.description: Comma-separated port ranges in format NNNN-NNNN (e.g. 25565-25570,25580-25590)

options.label: Pack
options.name: pack_id
options.description: The Pterodactyl pack ID to use for the server

options.label: Memory (MB)
options.name: memory
options.description: The amount of memory in MB allocated to the server

options.label: Swap (MB)
options.name: swap
options.description: The amount of swap memory in MB allocated to the server (0 disables swap)

options.label: CPU (%)
options.name: cpu
options.description: CPU limit as a percentage (e.g. 200 = 2 cores)

options.label: Disk (MB)
options.name: disk
options.description: The amount of disk space in MB allocated to the server

options.label: IO
options.name: io
options.description: Block IO adjustment number (higher = more I/O priority, typically 10-1000)

options.label: Startup Command
options.name: startup
options.description: Custom startup command override for the server (leave empty to use egg default)

options.label: Docker Image
options.name: image
options.description: Custom Docker image override for the server (leave empty to use egg default)

options.label: Databases
options.name: databases
options.description: Number of allowed database allocations (0 uses the panel default)

options.label: Allocations
options.name: allocations
options.description: Number of additional port allocations (0 uses the panel default)

options.label: Backups
options.name: backups
options.description: Number of allowed backups (0 uses the panel default)
